models.name: Sarvam 105B
models._contextWindowNote: NOT the model's 128k window. Sarvam's Azure gateway rejects large requests with a bare `403 Forbidden` long before the model's real limit — measured at ~29k tokens of ASCII filler by scripts/probe-context-limit.ts, and observed killing a live session at ~46k. A 403 is not a context-overflow signal, so Pi cannot recover from it: it just fails every turn from then on, forever, because the whole history is resent each time. Compaction triggers at contextWindow - compaction.reserveTokens, so this number is what makes it fire in time. 32000 leaves margin for Indic text, which costs more bytes per token than the probe's ASCII.
